data.title: 墨染希 · 咖啡馆打烊后的贴身揉面
data.description: 打烊后的星光咖啡馆后厨里，只留有一盏操作台上的暖光吊灯。系着奶黄围裙的希专注地揉着面包面团。当一双手臂从背后环过她的纤腰握住她的手时，希的动作一顿，耳根通红地向后靠进坚实的怀抱中，鼻尖还沾着一小抹白面粉。
data.action: kneading dough, back hug, blushing furiously, flour on cheek
data.lighting: warm hanging pendant lamp over stainless counter
data.promptProse: In the cozy back kitchen of the closed cafe, Sumizome Nozomi kneads bread dough in her striped yellow apron. When embraced from behind, she leans softly back into the hug, blushing furiously with a tiny dab of white flour on her cute cheek.
data.animaCaption: Nozomi embraced sweetly from behind in the bakery kitchen at night.
